items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Still got Harold and used Anderson, you see. Been using Anderson now about two years.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, he used Sales, you see. He had an outside job in Sales, he was playing Harold.
Still got Harold and used Anderson, you see. Been using Anderson now about two years.

items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: And Anderson, he keeps in touch with him near Mardi Gras, about three weeks before Mardi Gras.

ctx.x: You probably heard Lurie Armstrong or that and didn't even know him.

Yeah, I guess so. I was so little, you know, as soon as I hear a band, you know, our kids used to be, you know, I'd run out there and get on the sidewalk and I'd be with that long second line. But I think that's the one I can remember more, you know, that I followed. The tuxedo. And then there used to be the old Olympic. I don't know if they're still in existence, are they? No. Olympia. Because the Eureka, well, that's something that come up, that's just new to me when I come back home after the war. See, you…
He had the young tuxedo, John. I think Tillman's got it now since he died.
